description: Collects feedback but rarely turns it into strategic decisions.
Strong feedback interpretation authority memory and ethical learning.
Runs pilots but loses lessons because decision memory and reuse are weak.
Collects evidence but governance cannot change resources sequence or scope.
Power filters whose evidence counts and whose burden becomes visible.
Execution reviews activity but rarely tests the strategy assumptions.
Teams learn locally but lessons do not scale across the organization.
Uses retrospectives decision memory and governance to convert learning into action.
